name: CritPt
intro: CritPt（Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test）评估模型解决未发表、研究级物理问题的能力，并非识别物理临界点。50 多位活跃物理研究者基于自身研究创建 71 个复合挑战并拆成 190 个检查点，覆盖 11 个现代物理学科。
build_method: 物理研究者经基准培训后从自身未发表研究命题，设计只需公开知识、不可搜索、抗猜测且机器可验证的答案；问题经至少 3 轮、复杂题最多 10 轮迭代复核，再由相关领域同行、技术专家与科学写作专家审核，并拆成 2—4 个检查点
metric: 70 个测试挑战或 187 个测试检查点上 5 次独立运行的平均准确率；稳定解出率要求至少 4/5 次正确
eval_feature: 完整挑战和顺序检查点均采用自由解答→代码模板的两步生成；70 题完整批次由私有服务器判分，检查点论文实验分自行承接与注入前序专家答案两种设置
scale: 71 个挑战、190 个检查点；1 个公开样例、70 个私有答案测试挑战
build_method_en: After benchmark training, physics researchers author problems from their own unpublished work with public-knowledge-only, search-proof, guess-resistant, machine-verifiable answers; drafts receive 3+ and up to 10 revision rounds, related-area peer and technical review, science editing, and decomposition into 2-4 checkpoints
eval_feature_en: Both full challenges and sequential checkpoints use free-form-to-code-template two-step generation; complete 70-answer challenge batches use the private server, while the paper's checkpoint study compares self-carryover with injected prior expert answers
intro_en: CritPt (Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test) evaluates models on unpublished research-level physics problems; it is not about detecting physical critical points. More than 50 active researchers create 71 composite challenges decomposed into 190 checkpoints across 11 modern physics disciplines.
scale_en: 71 challenges and 190 checkpoints; 1 public example and 70 test challenges with private answers
metric_en: Average accuracy over 5 independent runs across 70 test challenges or 187 test checkpoints; consistently solved requires at least 4/5 correct runs
drawio_review_note: Aligned to arXiv:2509.26574v4 (especially §§2.2–4.3 and Appendices A.2–A.4), official repository 17c2545c302762d2f2d644d923ea4c301605cb08, and Hugging Face dataset revision 9b9fc8498596ec08ab5437a72f4aa18beef2b876. The paper reports 71 composite challenges and 190 checkpoints from 50+ researchers across 30+ institutions and 11 research areas; one worked example is public, while 70 test answers remain private and yield 187 test checkpoints. Authoring includes at least a one-hour briefing, detailed solutions, 3+ revision rounds (up to 10), LLM-response analysis without model-specific cherry-picking, related-area peer and technical review, science editing, and more than 40 expert hours on average. Both evaluation levels use free-form reasoning followed by code-template extraction. Challenge evaluation submits a complete 70-answer batch to the private server (10 submissions per 24 hours); numeric answers use expert tolerances and 12 significant digits for exact results, symbolic answers use SymPy-based equivalence, functions use curated tests, and every component of a composite answer must match. The checkpoint study is sequential and compares self-carryover against injected prior expert answers. Primary reporting is average accuracy over five independent runs; consistently solved requires at least four of five correct runs. Public questions, code, and an online challenge grader do not make the private gold answers or checkpoint grader public.
